_comment: CELPIP Speaking Task 6: Dealing with a Difficult Situation. The user chooses one option and speaks to that person.

items.scenario: You promised to help your friend move to a new apartment this Saturday. This morning, your manager asked you to work an important extra shift on the same day.

choices.text: Talk to your friend. Explain why you cannot help on Saturday, and suggest another way to help.
Talk to your manager. Explain why you cannot work the extra shift, and suggest a solution.

items.scenario: You have invited friends to dinner at your apartment tomorrow. Your roommate often leaves dirty dishes and clothes in the shared living areas, and the apartment is a mess.

choices.text: Talk to your roommate. Explain the problem, and ask for help before tomorrow.
Talk to one of your friends. Explain the situation, and suggest having the dinner somewhere else.

items.scenario: In team meetings, a coworker keeps presenting your ideas as if they were their own. Your manager is now planning to give this coworker the lead on a new project based on one of your ideas.

choices.text: Talk to your coworker. Explain how you feel, and ask them to give you credit in the future.
Talk to your manager. Explain the situation, and ask to be involved in the new project.

items.scenario: Your sister asked to borrow your car next weekend for a short holiday. Later, your best friend asked to borrow it on the same weekend to help her elderly mother move.

choices.text: Talk to your sister. Explain why you will lend the car to your friend instead.
Talk to your friend. Explain why you will lend the car to your sister instead.

items.scenario: You booked a table at a restaurant to celebrate your parents' 30th wedding anniversary. When you arrive with your parents, the restaurant says it gave your table to another group by mistake.

choices.text: Talk to the restaurant manager. Explain why this evening is important, and ask for a solution.
Talk to your parents. Apologize, and suggest a different plan for the evening.

items.scenario: Your daughter's soccer coach has moved practices to 4 p.m. on weekdays. You work until 5 p.m., so you cannot drive your daughter to practice anymore.

choices.text: Talk to the coach. Explain your situation, and ask if practices could start later.
Talk to another parent on the team. Explain your situation, and ask if you could share the driving.

items.scenario: You ordered a large cake for a surprise party for your friend tonight. The bakery has just called to say the cake will be ready two hours after the party starts.

choices.text: Talk to the baker. Explain why the time matters, and ask for a solution.
Talk to the friend who is hosting the party. Explain the problem, and suggest a new plan.

items.scenario: Your neighbour's large tree hangs over your yard. Its branches drop leaves into your swimming pool every day, and one branch looks like it could fall onto your roof.

choices.text: Talk to your neighbour. Explain the problem politely, and suggest a solution.
Talk to an officer at the city by-law office. Explain the situation, and ask what you can do.
